  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  October 12, 2023

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on October 12, 2023 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna , Planning Department
  Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Dept.

  Staff Present:  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on September 28, 2023.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Teresa Estada-Quintanar on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Halloween Family
  Festival Event at One W. Manchester Blvd, Inglewood City Hall ( South Lawn), Public
  property, on Saturday, October 21, 2023, from 1:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: IPD will staff two
  (2) Officers / Inglewood Emergency Service Department will staff two (2) Officers for Public
  safety; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end
  of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00364621)

 New Business License Request (s):

Item # 5:  Castulo De La Rocha DBA AltaMed PACE - Inglewood to operate as a Nusrsng/Healthcare
  Facility at 3310 W. Century Blvd. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license renewal and tax fees;
  Applicant must have accurate employment records on all employees at all times;Not to
  exceed six (6) tenants/patients without a city approved Special Use Permit.Business owner
  and/or facility is subject to random inspection by any city, county, or state Police and/or
  Code Enforcement officers during hours of operation to ensure patient(s) good welfare,
  health and safety; Business owner/employer is responsible for maintaining accurate and
  updated employee records for all employee’s;Business owner/facility is strictly prohibited
  from hiring or employing any person registered under California Penal Code Section 290
  PC or any person that may pose a public safety risk/threat to patients or other employees
  at the location; and Adhere to all State, Federal, County Laws and Inglewood Municipal
  Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of
  the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any
  future Business License application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00364653).
New Tobacco Retailer License Request (s):
Item # 6:  Harwinder Singh DBA Cherry Market to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 9737 S.
  Inglewood Ave. This Business License has been APPROVED with the following
  condition set forth by the Permits and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of
  Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS
  FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere
  to all State and Federal Rules and Regulations; Retail area not exceed 25% of total retail
  floor areaSales or display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of Flavored E-
  Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored Cartridges,
  Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored Smokeless
  Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own Tobacco,
  Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly
  Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age
  21 is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall
  have a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws
  restricting underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display
  of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are
  subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or
  night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to
  enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products
  within existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah
  products) to minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related
  tobacco products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction
  of underage tobacco use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal
